title: Science and technology
competency: Explain what technology is, how it is linked to science, and how both help society.

keywords.def: A systematic way of learning about the natural and physical world and human society, based on observation and evidence.
Using scientific knowledge to make work easier and life better, with materials, tools, techniques and sources of power.
A person who studies technology and uses science and mathematics to produce useful tools.

en.text: Technology is the use of scientific knowledge to help people work more easily and live better. It puts scientific knowledge into practice. Radios, bulbs, computers and airplanes are products of technology. A person who studies technology is a technologist.

am.text: ቴክኖሎጂ ሰዎች በቀላሉ እንዲሠሩና የተሻለ ኑሮ እንዲኖሩ ሳይንሳዊ እውቀትን መጠቀም ነው። ሳይንሳዊ እውቀትን ወደ ተግባር ይለውጣል። ሬዲዮ፣ አምፖል፣ ኮምፒውተርና አውሮፕላን የቴክኖሎጂ ውጤቶች ናቸው። ቴክኖሎጂን የሚያጠና ሰው ቴክኖሎጂስት ይባላል።

screens.title: Where did the phone come from?
screens.text: Mekdes uses a mobile phone to call her uncle in Bahir Dar.
screens.ask: How do you think the phone came to exist?
opts: People used science knowledge to make it
It was dug out of the ground ready to use
screens.after:
Phones do not grow or come out of the ground ready.
Scientists learnt how electricity and radio waves work.
Engineers used that knowledge to build the phone.
Using science to make useful things is technology. Read on.
screens.best: People used science knowledge to make it

screens.title: What is technology?
paras: Technology uses scientific knowledge to help people. They work more easily, live better and enjoy their environment.
It uses materials, tools, techniques and power. These make life easier and work more productive.
screens.note: In short: technology puts scientific knowledge into practice.

screens.title: Products and the people who make them
paras: Cars, TVs, radios, bulbs, microchips, computers, airplanes and home appliances are technology products.
A technologist studies technology. Technologists use science and mathematics to make very useful tools.

screens.title: From science to a tool: a solar lamp
steps: Science finds out: sunlight can be turned into electricity.
Technologists use that science and mathematics to design a solar panel.
They use materials, tools, techniques and power to build a lamp.
A village with no power now has light at night.
Life is easier and work goes on after dark. That is technology.

screens.title: Name it
defs: The use of scientific knowledge to help people work more easily and live better.
A person who studies technology and uses science and mathematics to produce useful tools.

screens.title: About technology
screens.text: Which statement about technology is correct?
opts: It is the study of nature for its own sake
It only means very old tools
It has nothing to do with science
It uses scientific knowledge to help people work more easily and live better
screens.ans: It uses scientific knowledge to help people work more easily and live better
screens.why:
Step 1: technology takes what science knows.
Step 2: it uses that knowledge to help people.
Step 3: people work more easily and live better.
So the last option is correct.
"Nothing to do with science" is wrong: technology puts science into practice.

screens.title: Who studies it?
screens.ask: Name the person: a person who studies technology is called a ___.
screens.why:
Take the word technology.
A person who studies it is a technologist (like biology → biologist).
Technologists use science and mathematics to make useful tools.
So the answer is technologist.
screens.clue: Change the end of the word "technology".

screens.title: True or false?
screens.text: Products of technology: a radio, a bulb and a computer are all products of technology.
screens.why:
The book lists products of technology.
The list has cars, TVs, radios, bulbs, microchips, computers, airplanes and home appliances.
Radio, bulb and computer are all in that list.
So the statement is true.
screens.clue: Read the list in "Products and the people who make them".

screens.title: A lamp for the village
screens.text: Engineers in Addis Ababa use what they know about electricity. They build a solar lamp for a village with no power.
screens.why:
Step 1: the engineers already know about electricity. That is science knowledge.
Step 2: they use it to make a lamp that solves a real problem.
Step 3: putting science knowledge into practice is technology.
So the answer is technology.
It is not indigenous science: the knowledge is not from local experience.
screens.clue: Are they finding out why, or making something useful?
screens.ask: Building a solar lamp is mainly an example of:
screens.worked:
Step 1: the engineers know how electricity works (science).
Step 2: they use that knowledge to build a solar lamp.
Step 3: the lamp solves a real problem: a village with no power.
Putting science into practice is technology.

en.text: Science and technology are closely connected but different. Science produces knowledge and tests explanations. Technology makes human-made solutions to real problems. Science uses technology to gain knowledge, and technology uses scientific knowledge. Together they help agriculture, medicine, construction and industry.

am.text: ሳይንስና ቴክኖሎጂ በጣም የተያያዙ ቢሆኑም የተለያዩ ናቸው። ሳይንስ እውቀትን ያፈራል፤ ማብራሪያዎችንም ይፈትሻል። ቴክኖሎጂ ለእውነተኛ ችግሮች ሰው ሠራሽ መፍትሔዎችን ያዘጋጃል። ሳይንስ እውቀት ለማግኘት ቴክኖሎጂን ይጠቀማል፤ ቴክኖሎጂም ሳይንሳዊ እውቀትን ይጠቀማል። በጋራ ግብርናን፣ ሕክምናን፣ ግንባታንና ኢንዱስትሪን ይረዳሉ።

screens.title: Question or tool?
screens.text: Before you read, sort these. Does each one ask a question, or make something useful?
items: It is a question about nature.
It is a made object that people use.
How do bacteria grow in a dish?
It is a question about nature.

screens.title: How they connect
paras: Science and technology are closely connected. But they are different fields with different aims.
Science produces knowledge for its own sake. It proposes and tests explanations.

screens.caption: Science gives knowledge. Technology puts it to work.

screens.title: Each helps the other
paras: Technology develops human-made solutions to real-world problems.
Science uses technology to gain knowledge. Technology uses scientific knowledge to make solutions.
screens.note: A microscope (technology) helps us see cells (science).

screens.title: Two different aims
defs: Produces knowledge for its own sake. It asks why and how, and tests explanations.
Develops human-made solutions to real-world problems. It asks how to make a job easier.

screens.title: What technology asks
opts: How can we solve this real problem or make this job easier?
screens.ans: How can we solve this real problem or make this job easier?
screens.why:
Step 1: science asks why or how something happens.
Step 2: technology has a different aim.
Step 3: it makes human-made solutions to real-world problems.
So it asks: how can we solve this real problem or make this job easier?
"Who discovered it first?" is a history question, not technology.
screens.clue: Compare the aims of science and technology you just read.
screens.ask: What question does technology mainly ask?

screens.title: Science or technology?
screens.text: Sort each one: science or technology?
items: Finding out why plants need light
It asks a question and tests an explanation.
It is a product made to solve a real need.
Testing an idea about how heat moves
It gains knowledge and tests explanations.
Building a lamp that runs on solar power
It uses scientific knowledge to solve a real problem.
Asking how bacteria grow in a dish
It aims to understand something in nature.
screens.why:
Step 1: ask of each card: is it a question about nature, or a made thing?
Step 2: questions and tests of ideas (why plants need light, how heat moves, how bacteria grow) are science.
Step 3: made things that solve a need (radio, solar lamp, computer, airplane) are technology.
Science seeks knowledge. Technology makes solutions.
screens.clue: Ask: is it a question about nature, or a made thing that solves a problem?

screens.title: Uses of science and technology for society
paras: Science and technology play an important role in daily life. They make new materials that meet people's needs.
They help agriculture, medicine, environment and population, construction and making products.

screens.title: Uses of science and technology
items: New knowledge and tools help farmers grow more food. Ethiopian example: improved sorghum varieties developed by Dr. Gebisa Ejeta.
Science and technology help make medicines and drugs. Ethiopian example: Dr. Aklilu Lemma's research on the endod plant against bilharzia.
They help people understand and manage environmental problems and population growth.
They give us building materials and methods for houses, roads and bridges.
Industry makes cosmetics, textiles, dyes, soaps and detergents, plastics, rubber, metals and non-metals, alcoholic drinks, dry cells and car batteries.
screens.ask: Tap each area to see how science and technology help.

screens.title: Helping medicine
screens.text: Uses of science and technology: which of these shows them helping medicine?
screens.why:
Step 1: medicine is about treating and preventing disease.
Step 2: the book lists the production of medicines and drugs.
Step 3: car batteries, roads and dyed cloth are other areas: industry and construction.
So the answer is making new medicines and drugs.

screens.title: Two-way link
screens.ask: The two-way link: science uses technology to gain knowledge. Technology uses scientific ___ to make solutions.
screens.why:
Science and technology help each other.
Science uses tools (technology) to gain knowledge.
Technology uses that knowledge to make solutions.
So the missing word is knowledge.

screens.title: A microscope in Jimma
screens.text: A biologist in Jimma uses a microscope to look at cells in a leaf.
opts: Technology is helping science gain knowledge
Science is helping technology build a tool
Science and technology are not linked here
screens.ans: Technology is helping science gain knowledge
screens.why:
Step 1: the microscope is a made tool, so it is technology.
Step 2: learning about leaf cells is new knowledge, so it is science.
Step 3: the tool helps the scientist learn.
So technology is helping science gain knowledge.
It is not the other way round: nobody is building a tool here.
screens.clue: Which part is the tool, and which part is the new knowledge?
screens.ask: What does this show about science and technology?
screens.worked:
Step 1: the microscope is a made tool: technology.
Step 2: the biologist wants to learn about cells: science.
Step 3: the tool lets her see what her eyes cannot.
So technology helps science gain knowledge.

test.text: A team uses what it knows about electricity to build a solar lamp for a village. This is:
test.why:
Step 1: the team uses science knowledge about electricity.
Step 2: they build a lamp that solves a real problem.
Step 3: that is putting science into practice.
So it is technology.

test.text: Uses for society: science and technology play a role in agriculture, medicine, construction and the making of soaps and plastics.
test.why:
The lesson lists the areas where science and technology help.
They are agriculture, medicine, environment and population, construction and making products.
Soaps and plastics are among the products made by industry.
So the statement is true.

test.ask: Name the person: someone who studies technology is called a ___.
test.why:
A technologist studies technology.
Technologists use science and mathematics to make useful tools.
So the answer is technologist.
